cards.title: Variables hold values
cards.body: A variable is a name for a value. `=` stores the value on the right under the name on the left. Use the name later to get the value back.

hi.title: Variables values rakhte hain
hi.body: Variable kisi value ka naam hota hai. `=` right side ki value ko left side ke naam mein store karta hai. Baad mein woh naam likho aur value wapas mil jaayegi.

cards.title: Reading input
cards.body: `input()` reads one line that the user types and gives it back as text. Store it in a variable to use it.

hi.title: Input padhna
hi.body: `input()` user ki type ki hui ek line padhta hai aur use text ki tarah wapas deta hai. Use karne ke liye use ek variable mein store karo.

cards.title: Joining text with +
cards.body: Use `+` to glue strings together. Python adds no spaces for you, so put the spaces and punctuation in yourself.

hi.title: + se text jodna
hi.body: Strings ko jodne ke liye `+` use karo. Python khud se koi space nahi daalta, isliye spaces aur punctuation aapko khud lagane honge.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: It should greet the name you type in, but Python stops with a `NameError`. Which line is wrong?

bug.fix: Line 3 asks for `greting`, but the variable is called `greeting`. Python only knows the names you have made.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: Isse aapka type kiya hua naam greet karna chahiye, par Python `NameError` dekar ruk jaata hai. Kaunsi line galat hai?
hi.fix: Line 3 `greting` maangti hai, par variable ka naam `greeting` hai. Python sirf wahi naam jaanta hai jo aapne banaye hain.

check.question: What does this print?
check.explanation: `animal` holds "cat", and + joins the pieces exactly as they are, with no extra spaces.

hi.question: Yeh kya print karega?
hi.explanation: `animal` mein "cat" hai, aur + pieces ko bilkul waise hi jodta hai jaise woh hain, bina extra space ke.

exercise.prompt: Read a name from input and print `Hi, <name>!`. For `Ada`, print `Hi, Ada!`
exercise.promptHi: Input se ek naam padho aur `Hi, <name>!` print karo. `Ada` ke liye `Hi, Ada!` print karo.
